propositions: Plan review and code review must derive criteria selection from one immutable effective-policy snapshot rather than independent registry/routing/runner/checkpoint paths

The shared discovery executor must emit typed outcomes (success, resumed, skipped, shed, failed, cancelled) and enforce budget/applicability/checkpointing, while gate strategies retain context and verdict logic
Project code-review LLM criteria require non-empty repository-relative globs; empty-list semantics must migrate to explicit ["**"] convention
rebar review-plan --retry must reuse content-identical successes, retry only missing work with fresh budget, and refuse stale lineages before any model call
Code review preserves sequential execution and no checkpoints; plan review moves to digest-complete checkpoint namespace while preserving chunking/concurrency/cache behavior
Discovery trace must be versioned and typed for audit/retry, but review/review-status responses remain narrow end-result contracts without per-unit debugging or provider details
